```yaml
name: Label dependencies PRs

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Add dependencies label
        if: ${{ github.actor == 'dependabot[bot]' || github.actor == 'transifex-integration[bot]' || github.actor == 'imgbot[bot]' }}
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const label = ':heavy_check_mark: dependencies';
            await github.issues.addLabels({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              labels: [label]
            });
```
